name: wiraui-monorepo
description: WiraUI: Angular UI components and Theme Designer (v1 Angular 15–17, v2 18–20, v3 21+)

scripts.build: pnpm build:core && pnpm build:themes && pnpm build:schematics && pnpm build:ng && pnpm build:icons
scripts.build:ng: pnpm --filter @wiraui-build/angular-v1 build && pnpm --filter @wiraui-build/angular-v2 build && pnpm --filter @wiraui-build/angular-v3 build
scripts.pack:all: pnpm build && pnpm --filter "./packages/angular-v*" run pack && pnpm --filter @wiraui-build/icons run pack
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @wiraui/core test && pnpm --filter @wiraui/themes test && pnpm --filter @wiraui/schematics test && pnpm --filter @wiraui-build/icons test
scripts.docs: node tools/build-docs-packages.mjs && cd apps/docs && npx ng build
